mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM ai_chat_dialogue d JOIN (SELECT create_time AS before_time FROM ai_chat_dialogue WHERE id = #{beforeId}) b ON d.create_time < b.before_time OR (d.create_time = b.before_time AND d.id <= #{beforeId}) WHERE d.topic_id = #{topicId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.create_time DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{size};

SELECT HOUR(a.create_time) as hour, COUNT(*) as call_count, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, u.create_time, a.create_time)) / 1000 as avg_response_time, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status = 1 OR a.feedback_status = 0, 1, 0)) as positive_count, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status = -1, 1, 0)) as negative_count, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status IN (1, 0, -1), 1, 0)) as feedback_total, SUM(IF(JSON_EXTRACT(a.metadata, '$.hasError') = true, 1, 0)) as error_count FROM ai_chat_dialogue a INNER JOIN ai_chat_dialogue u ON u.id = a.last_id AND u.sender = 'user' AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.create_time >= #{startTime} AND a.create_time < #{endTime} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.sender = 'assistant' GROUP BY HOUR(a.create_time) ORDER BY hour

SELECT HOUR(a.create_time) as hour, COUNT(*) as call_count, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, u.create_time, a.create_time)) / 1000 as avg_response_time, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status = 1 OR a.feedback_status = 0, 1, 0)) as positive_count, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status = -1, 1, 0)) as negative_count, SUM(IF(a.feedback_status IN (1, 0, -1), 1, 0)) as feedback_total, SUM(IF(JSON_EXTRACT(a.metadata, '$.hasError') = true, 1, 0)) as error_count FROM ai_chat_dialogue a INNER JOIN ai_chat_dialogue u ON u.id = a.last_id AND u.sender = 'user' AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.create_time >= #{startTime} AND a.create_time < #{endTime} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.sender = 'assistant' GROUP BY HOUR(a.create_time) ORDER BY hour
